title: VaultWireValidator
responsibility: Validates Credential Vault broker wire messages: session requests, device proofs, V2 approval decisions and lease calls.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerError.constructor.status
inputs.description: HTTP status the broker answers with.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerError.constructor.message
inputs.description: Refusal text with no secret detail.

inputs.name: binary.min
inputs.description: Minimum decoded length in bytes.

inputs.name: binary.max
inputs.description: Maximum decoded length in bytes; defaults to min.

inputs.name: VaultWireValidator.parse.schema
inputs.description: One of the wire schemas.

inputs.name: VaultWireValidator.parse.input
inputs.description: Untrusted decoded value.
inputs.unknownReason: The value is untrusted until the schema accepts it.

inputs.name: VaultWireValidator.parse.label
inputs.description: Message name used in the refusal, such as request or decision.

inputs.name: VaultWireValidator.json.schema
inputs.description: One of the wire schemas.

inputs.name: VaultWireValidator.json.bytes
inputs.description: Untrusted message bytes.

inputs.name: VaultWireValidator.json.label
inputs.description: Message name used in the refusal.

outputs.name: binary
outputs.description: A schema for unpadded base64url decoding to min..max bytes.

outputs.name: vaultSessionRequest
outputs.description: Strict schema of a session request: item, session, project, environment, site, action, account, mode, method, recipe ref, host, runner key, origins, lease length and reason.

outputs.name: vaultTicket
outputs.description: Strict schema of a request id and receipt.

outputs.name: vaultProof
outputs.description: Strict schema of a device proof: device id, nonce, payload and P-256 signature.

outputs.name: vaultSealed
outputs.description: Strict schema of a sealed envelope.

outputs.name: vaultDecision
outputs.description: Approve, restating the full scope and a nullable sealed credential, or deny.

outputs.name: vaultChallenge
outputs.description: Strict schema of a challenge request: device id.

outputs.name: vaultLeaseCall
outputs.description: Strict schema of a lease id and session.

outputs.name: vaultLeaseIssue
outputs.description: A ticket plus the verified identity and teardown paths.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 400 'Invalid <label> at <field path>.' when the input fails the schema; the value is never echoed.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 400 'Invalid <label>: not UTF-8 JSON.' when the bytes are not UTF-8 JSON.
